content: ललाम {%a.%} (-मी|{%f.%}) .²1 Beautiful, lovely, charming. .²2 Having a mark on the forehead marked with a blaze. .{@-मम्@} .²1 An ornament for the forehead, an ornament or decoration in general; ({%m.%} also in this sense); सद्यः पुनाति सहचन्द्रललामलोकान् <ls>Bhāg. 3. 16. 9</ls>; अहं तु तामाश्रमललामभूतां शकुन्तलामधिकृत्य ब्रवीमि <ls>Ś. 2</ls>; <ls>Śi. 4. 28</ls>. .²2 Anything the best of its kind. .²3 A mark on the forehead. .²4 A sign, symbol, mark in general. .²5 A banner, flag. .²6 A row, series, line. .²7 A tail. .²8 A mane. .²9 Eminence, dignity, beauty. .²10 A horn. .{@-मः@} A horse; <ls>Mb. 7. 23. 13</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> ‘श्वेतं ललाटमध्यस्थं तारारूपं हयस्य यत् . ललामं चापि तत्प्राहुर्ललामाश्वस्तदन्वितः ..’).
